<!-- The search is progressively enhanced: all entries remain readable without JS.
To add an item, duplicate a resource-card div, give it a unique ID, and edit
data-category. Search automatically includes all visible text in the card.
For downloads, add files/topic.pdf and link to it inside the relevant card. -->
```{=html}
<div class="resource-tools" id="resource-tools" hidden>
  <div class="resource-search">
    <label for="resource-search">Find something useful</label>
    <input id="resource-search" type="search" placeholder="Search notes, topics, or formats…" aria-controls="resource-library">
  </div>
  <div class="resource-category">
    <label for="resource-category">Show</label>
    <select id="resource-category" aria-controls="resource-library">
      <option value="all">Everything</option>
      <option value="study">Study sheets</option>
      <option value="documents">Documents</option>
      <option value="collections">Collections</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>

<p class="resource-count" id="resource-count" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" hidden></p>
```

::: {.shelf-note}
**A note about this shelf**

If you’re taking one of these courses, feel free to use my notes and study guides as a supplemental resource. I built them to strengthen my own understanding, and I’m sharing them in case they help you too.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const search = document.getElementById('resource-search');
  const category = document.getElementById('resource-category');
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('.resource-card')];
  const count = document.getElementById('resource-count');
  const empty = document.getElementById('resource-empty');
  const update = () => {
    const terms = search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let visible = 0;
    cards.forEach(card => {
      const text = card.textContent.toLocaleLowerCase();
      const matches = terms.every(term => text.includes(term)) &&
        (category.value === 'all' || card.dataset.category === category.value);
      card.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) visible++;
    });
    count.textContent = `${visible} of ${cards.length} resources`;
    empty.hidden = visible !== 0;
  };
  document.getElementById('resource-tools').hidden = false;
  count.hidden = false;
  search.addEventListener('input', update);
  category.addEventListener('change', update);
  update();
})();
</script>
```
